title: IAudioService factory table, Android 13 Spatializer backport and CodeLinaro audio service

explained_differences.Landroid/media/AudioManager;: isBluetoothScoAvailableOffCall() (CodeLinaro logging hunk): the only difference is the framework-res ID of config_bluetooth_sco_off_call (factory 0x01110036, Source 0x01110034); the body is otherwise identical. Resource IDs of framework-res are not ported.

explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/audio/AudioService;: getDeviceForStream(I): the ported CodeLinaro change only makes the method public/@VisibleForTesting (access matches). The factory body additionally masks DEVICE_OUT_REMOTE_SUBMIX (0x8000) and 0x2000000 out of the multi-device selection; this is a PICO device-selection change without a donor, outside IAudioService, not ported. All other ported AudioService members (IAudioService implementation, Spatializer wiring, capture-policy restore in onAudioServerDied, A2DP active device change) are identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/audio/BtHelper;: mapBluetoothCodecToAudioFormat(I): the factory maps the QTI codecs CELT, APTX_ADAPTIVE and APTX_TWSP (BluetoothCodecConfig SOURCE_CODEC_TYPE_* 5..7 and AudioSystem AUDIO_FORMAT_* 0x26/0x27/0x2A000000). The Qualcomm codec numbering belongs to the QTI Bluetooth stack and is not present in the Source BluetoothCodecConfig (decision of stages 0047/0067-0069, factory Bluetooth.apk keeps its own copy), so the CodeLinaro codec hunks of BtHelper and AudioSystem are not applied. Everything else in BtHelper (TWS+ SCO handling) is identical.

native_dependency.summary: The factory Spatializer and setRecordSilenced are backed by PICO native audio server code that has no counterpart in the Android 10 Source audio stack. The Java side is ported; the three JNI entry points report an audio policy service without these features.
native_dependency.factory_property: vendor/build.prop ro.audio.spatializer_enabled=true (vendor stays factory, so AudioService initializes SpatializerHelper with effectExpected=true)

factory_libandroid_runtime_jni.AudioSystem.native_register_track_state_: PICO track state callback, not part of this port

factory_libaudioclient: AudioSystem::getSpatializer/canBeSpatialized/setRecordSilenced through IAudioPolicyService vtable slots 0x268/0x270/0x260 (factory IAudioPolicyService is AIDL-generated: getDefaultImpl/setDefaultImpl)
AIDL cpp media::ISpatializer, INativeSpatializerCallback, ISpatializerHeadTrackingCallback, SpatializationLevel, SpatializationMode, SpatializerHeadTrackingMode
factory_audioserver: libaudiopolicyservice: Spatializer (effect control, Spatializer-looper, SpatializerPoseController, dynamic per-player spatialization: enableSpatialization/setAudioOrientation/setAudioPose, persist.audio.spatial_pose.*)
vendor audio_effects.xml spatializer effect and audio_policy_configuration.xml spatializer mix port

source_behavior.nativeGetSpatializer: returns null: SpatializerHelper.init logs 'No Spatializer found' and the state becomes STATE_NOT_SUPPORTED, as on a factory audio policy service without a spatializer
